name: mcp-office-suite
description: One install for the whole freelancer office suite: time tracking, price watching, spreadsheets and PDF invoicing, proxied behind a single MCP server.

license_key.title: License key
license_key.description: Optional Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Leave blank to use the free tier.

tools.name: timer_start
tools.description: Start a stopwatch for billable work on a project or client (timesheet / hours per project). Only one timer runs at a time: starting a new one stops and logs the previous one.

tools.name: timer_stop
tools.description: Stop the running timer and log it as a time entry. Returns the duration and the entry id.

tools.name: timer_status
tools.description: Show the running timer, how long it has been running, and today's total hours so far.

tools.name: entry_add
tools.description: Log billable (or non-billable) time you already worked on a project - a timesheet entry. Give start plus either end or minutes, and optionally the hourly rate and its currency, e.g. rate '90 euros an hour' -> EUR.

tools.name: entry_list
tools.description: List logged time entries (timesheet rows) as a compact table, with hours, billable flag and project. Free tier shows the last 7 days.

tools.name: entry_delete
tools.description: Delete one time entry by id.

tools.name: entry_edit
tools.description: Change fields of an existing entry. Only the fields you pass are changed.

tools.name: project_set_rate
tools.description: Set the hourly rate and currency used to turn tracked hours into money for a project or client. Returns the new rate and, when re-rating is asked for, how many already logged entries changed.

tools.name: report
tools.description: Timesheet report: total tracked hours and billable money for a period, optionally grouped by (group by) project, day, task or tag - hours per project, how much to bill. Omit group_by for the plain total per currency.

tools.name: export_csv
tools.description: Call this tool to export the timesheet to a CSV file (excel-friendly) you can hand to a bookkeeper: one row per entry with hours, billable, rate, currency and amount. Returns the file path written.

tools.name: entry_mark_billed
tools.description: Close the loop after an invoice is issued: stamp the tracked hours that went on it with the invoice number, so report and invoice_summary stop offering them and the same hours are never billed twice.

tools.name: invoice_summary
tools.description: Turn tracked billable time into invoice line items for one project or client: hours, hourly rate, amount per task and the total, in the currency the work was logged in (EUR 225.00, not $225.00).

tools.name: license_status
tools.description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

tools.name: license_activate
tools.description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.

tools.name: sheet_info
tools.description: Call this tool for any spreadsheet or CSV file path; built-in file readers cannot parse spreadsheets and must not be used for them. Start here: sheet names, size, header row, column types and samples.

tools.name: sheet_read
tools.description: Call this tool for any spreadsheet or CSV file path; built-in file readers cannot parse spreadsheets and must not be used for them. Reads rows as a table, JSON or CSV; page with limit/offset or an A1 range.

tools.name: sheet_query
tools.description: Call this tool for any spreadsheet or CSV file path; built-in file readers cannot parse spreadsheets and must not be used for them. Filters, groups, aggregates and sorts in one call, e.g. where '[Qty] > 10'.

tools.name: sheet_stats
tools.description: Call this tool for any spreadsheet or CSV file path; built-in file readers cannot parse spreadsheets and must not be used for them. Whole-column statistics: count, empty, distinct, min, max, sum, mean, median.

tools.name: sheet_find
tools.description: Call this tool to search every cell of a spreadsheet or CSV for text; built-in file readers cannot parse spreadsheets. Matching is case insensitive. Returns cell addresses with a preview of the row each hit is on.

tools.name: sheet_write
tools.description: Call this tool to write rows to an excel (xlsx) or csv/tsv/json file. Returns the rows, columns, byte size and column names of the file written.

tools.name: sheet_add_column
tools.description: Call this tool to add a computed column and save the result to a NEW file; the source is never modified unless out_path points at it. Returns the new file path, the row count and a preview of the first rows.

tools.name: sheet_convert
tools.description: Call this tool to convert a sheet between excel (xlsx), csv and json. Writes a new file next to the source unless out_path is given; the source is never modified. Returns the new file path with its row and column counts.

tools.name: business_set
tools.description: The ONE business profile for the whole suite: name, address, VAT id, bank details and defaults (currency, tax rate, terms, prefix, timezone). Saved to the shared profile every other server reads. Call it once, first.

tools.name: client_add
tools.description: Store a client so invoices can refer to them by name. Re-adding the same name updates the stored details.

tools.name: client_list
tools.description: List every stored client with their id, address, email and VAT id.

tools.name: invoice_create
tools.description: Create an invoice for a client from a list of items. Allocates the next invoice number (never reused) and returns the stored invoice with its subtotal, discount, one tax line per rate and the total.

tools.name: invoice_from_hours
tools.description: Shortcut for the common case: bill one client for N hours at an hourly rate. Creates and returns a single-line invoice, converting the rate into target_currency when you supply fx_rates, and echoing back any entry_ids.

tools.name: invoice_list
tools.description: List invoices, optionally filtered by status (unpaid, paid, partial), client, and an issue-date range.

tools.name: invoice_get
tools.description: Return the full stored record for one invoice number, including every line and tax breakdown.

tools.name: invoice_mark_paid
tools.description: Record a payment. Without an amount the invoice is marked fully paid; a smaller amount marks it partial and reports the remaining balance.

tools.name: invoice_pdf
tools.description: Call this tool to render a stored invoice as an A4 PDF you can send. Returns the path of the file written.

tools.name: overdue_report
tools.description: Answer "which invoices are overdue?": every unpaid or partly paid invoice past its due date, with days overdue, the outstanding amount per invoice and the outstanding total per currency. Free and unlimited.

tools.name: expense_add
tools.description: Record one expense and return its id, its net/VAT split and its billable flag. The response states every default that was applied, so the caller can see what was assumed rather than having to guess.

tools.name: expense_list
tools.description: List expenses in a date range, optionally filtered by project, category or billable flag. Totals are grouped by currency and never mixed.

tools.name: expense_update
tools.description: Change any field of a stored expense by id. Only the fields you pass are changed.

tools.name: expense_delete
tools.description: Delete one expense by id. The receipt file itself is left on disk.

tools.name: receipt_attach
tools.description: Call this tool to attach a receipt file to a stored expense. Returns the stored path and sha256. The file must exist; it is hashed so a later audit can prove the file has not changed.

tools.name: category_rules
tools.description: Replace the merchant-to-category rules, or call with no rules to list them. Returns the stored rule list. The rules are applied by expense_add whenever a call gives no category of its own.

tools.name: expense_settings
tools.description: Read or set the defaults expense_add uses when a call does not name them: default_vat_rate and default_currency. Returns the stored defaults. Call with no arguments to read them without changing anything.

tools.name: expense_summary
tools.description: Totals for a date range grouped by category, project, month or merchant. Every group is reported per currency with the gross, the net and the VAT; currencies are never added together.

tools.name: mileage_add
tools.description: Record a business trip as an expense, priced as distance x rate. Give exactly one of km or miles. Returns the saved id with the rate used, where that rate came from and the money, in the rate's own currency.

tools.name: expense_export
tools.description: Call this tool to write the expenses in a date range to a csv, xlsx or json file. Returns the path. The money column is `amount` (gross), as in time-tracker's export_csv, with `gross`, `net`, `vat` alongside.

tools.name: expense_to_invoice
tools.description: Preview the unbilled billable expenses of one project as invoice_create line items (description, quantity, unit_price, tax_rate), grouped per currency. Read-only: nothing is marked rebilled here.

tools.name: expense_mark_rebilled
tools.description: Mark expenses as rebilled once the invoice that carries them actually exists. Pass the expense_ids of one currency group from expense_to_invoice, or that project, date range and currency. Returns what was marked.

tools.name: rates_latest
tools.description: Call this tool for the most recent European Central Bank daily reference rates, re-expressed against any base. Returns the rates, the ECB rate date they belong to, and how old the local cache is.

tools.name: convert
tools.description: Call this tool to convert an amount between any two ECB-quoted currencies, today or on a past date. Returns the converted amount, the cross rate to 6 decimals, the rounding applied and the rate date used.

tools.name: convert_many
tools.description: One amount, one source currency, many targets, all off the same ECB rate date. Each result is rounded to that target's own minor units.

tools.name: fx_rates_for
tools.description: Call this tool when a rebill or an invoice spans more than one currency, instead of asking the user for rates. Returns the fx_rates object expense_to_invoice takes, plus the rate date to write on the invoice.

tools.name: rate_history
tools.description: Call this tool for the ECB rate of one currency pair across a window. Returns one row per published day plus the min, max, average and the change over the whole window.

tools.name: rate_on
tools.description: Call this tool for the ECB rate of one pair on one date. Returns both directions, the date the rate came from, and which way round the ECB publishes the pair, so a reciprocal is never reported as the published figure.

tools.name: currencies_list
tools.description: Every currency in the ECB daily reference set, with its rate against the euro and the number of decimal places it is rounded to. Anything not on this list cannot be converted here.

tools.name: cache_status
tools.description: What is cached on this machine, how old it is, and when it will next be refreshed. Answer this before trusting a rate on a machine that has been offline.

tools.name: now
tools.description: The current time in one or more places. Accepts IANA zones (Europe/Warsaw), city names (Warsaw), country names (Poland) or abbreviations (PST, IST). With no zones it reports this machine's local zone and UTC.

tools.name: convert_time
tools.description: Convert a time from one place to others. The input time is read as wall-clock time in from_zone unless it carries an offset or a trailing Z. Accepts '2026-09-10 15:00', an ISO timestamp, or a phrase like '3pm tomorrow'.

tools.name: overlap
tools.description: The window each day when every listed place is inside working hours. Computed on a real date, so a DST week that widens or narrows the overlap is reflected.

tools.name: find_meeting_slots
tools.description: Rank the times when every participant is inside their own working hours. Returns each slot as a UTC instant with the local time for every participant and a fairness score, best first.

tools.name: dst_changes
tools.description: The clock changes in a place for a year, with the exact UTC instant and the offset before and after. Use it to check whether a recurring call moves for one of you in March or October.

tools.name: business_days
tools.description: Count the business days between two dates in a place, for delivery dates and payment terms. Returns the business-day count, the calendar total, and how many days fell on a weekend or on a holiday you passed.

tools.name: contacts_set
tools.description: Remember a client or teammate's time zone and working hours so you can say 'find a slot with Maria and Raj' later.

tools.name: contacts_list
tools.description: Everyone you have saved, with their current local time and whether they are inside working hours right now.

tools.name: ics_create
tools.description: Call this tool to write a .ics calendar file for one meeting. Returns the path written and the meeting time in UTC and in the zone you gave.

tools.name: doc_create
tools.description: Call this tool to write a real .docx file from structured sections. Returns the file path, the number of blocks written and the layout used. Free and unlimited.

tools.name: doc_from_markdown
tools.description: Call this tool to turn markdown into a .docx. Returns the file path and a count of the blocks written, by type. Free and unlimited.

tools.name: doc_read
tools.description: Call this tool to extract the text of an existing .docx. Returns an outline of the headings and the full text in document order, or the block structure. Free and unlimited.

tools.name: doc_to_html
tools.description: Call this tool to convert a .docx to semantic HTML you can open in a browser and print to PDF. Returns the path of the .html file. This is the supported PDF route; no PDF is rendered here. Free and unlimited.

tools.name: doc_fill_template
tools.description: Call this tool to replace {{placeholders}} in an existing .docx and write a new file. Returns the new path and which placeholders were replaced, unfilled or ignored. Call with no values to list a template's placeholders.

tools.name: proposal_create
tools.description: Call this tool to produce a client-ready .docx proposal from summary, scope, deliverables, timeline, price and terms. Returns the reference, the total and the file path. Free tier: 3 proposals or contracts per month.

tools.name: proposal_update
tools.description: Rewrite an existing proposal in place from its reference. Only the fields you pass change; the rest comes from the data stored at creation. Returns the fields that changed and the file path.

tools.name: contract_create
tools.description: Call this tool to produce a freelance service agreement .docx. Returns the reference, the fee and the file path. It is a template skeleton for a lawyer to review, not legal advice. Free tier: 3 agreements per month.

tools.name: profile_set
tools.description: Store the profile every resume and cover letter is built from: contact details, summary, skills, roles with bullets, education, certifications and languages. Returns a count of what was stored.

tools.name: profile_get
tools.description: Return the stored profile as JSON, exactly as it will be used by resume_create, cover_letter_create and tailor_to_job.

tools.name: resume_create
tools.description: Call this tool to write the stored profile to a Word .docx. Returns the output path, the estimated page count, which bullets were dropped to fit, and which keywords matched or are missing.

tools.name: resume_to_markdown
tools.description: Return the stored profile as markdown: paste it into a form, an email or an ATS box.

tools.name: resume_to_html
tools.description: Call this tool to write the resume as semantic HTML with a print stylesheet. Returns the output path. Open the file in a browser and print it to PDF.

tools.name: resume_read
tools.description: Call this tool to extract an existing Word resume into the profile shape: name, contact, summary, skills, roles with bullets, education. Returns the parsed profile, the sections found, and anything unparsed.

tools.name: cover_letter_create
tools.description: Call this tool to write a one-page cover letter from the stored profile: opening, fit, proof, close. Returns the output path, the word count, and every bracketed prompt left for you to fill in.

tools.name: tailor_to_job
tools.description: READ-ONLY gap analysis against a posting: writes nothing, changes nothing. Returns matched keywords, missing ones, a coverage figure and orderings of facts you already stated. Act on it with resume_create.

tools.name: schedule_create
tools.description: Define a repeating invoice: a client, the line items, how often to bill, and when it starts and ends. Returns the schedule id, a summary and its next dates. Nothing is invoiced until invoice_generate_due runs.

tools.name: schedule_list
tools.description: Every schedule with its cadence, per-period amount, next due date and status (active or paused).

tools.name: schedule_get
tools.description: The full stored record for one schedule: items, cadence, dates, rules and how many invoices it has generated.

tools.name: schedule_update
tools.description: Change a schedule's client, items, currency, cadence, dates, due days, notes or auto_generate flag. Periods already invoiced are never re-issued, so changing the amount affects future invoices only.

tools.name: schedule_pause
tools.description: Stop a schedule from generating invoices without deleting it. Its history is kept and it can be resumed.

tools.name: schedule_resume
tools.description: Make a paused schedule active again. Periods that fell due while it was paused are still due and will be created by the next invoice_generate_due.

tools.name: schedule_delete
tools.description: Remove a schedule. Invoices it already generated stay in the invoice server untouched and its generation history is kept as an audit trail. Returns the client and how many invoices and history rows remain.

tools.name: schedule_skip
tools.description: Skip a single occurrence of a schedule without pausing it: no invoice is ever created for that period, and every other period bills as normal. Returns the amount that will not be billed and how to undo it.

tools.name: schedule_upcoming
tools.description: Table of every schedule occurrence falling due in the next N days, with the amount per occurrence and the total per currency. Free lists the first 3 occurrences in the horizon you ask for.

tools.name: invoice_generate_due
tools.description: Create a real invoice in the invoice server for every schedule occurrence on or before as_of that has not been invoiced yet, and render each PDF. Returns what was created, what was skipped and what is still due.

tools.name: schedule_history
tools.description: The audit log for one schedule: every period it has generated, the invoice number, dates, amount and PDF path.

tools.name: forecast
tools.description: Expected invoiced revenue per calendar month per currency from every active schedule. Free covers 3 months ahead; Pro covers up to 120.

tools.name: clause_add
tools.description: Save a reusable contract or proposal clause to the library. Returns the stored clause id, title, category, tags and the variables detected in its body, plus how many clauses of your own the library now holds.

tools.name: clause_get
tools.description: Return a clause in full by id or by title, with its variables and, in Pro, its revision count.

tools.name: clause_update
tools.description: Change the text, category, tags, variables or jurisdiction of a clause. In Pro the previous text is kept as a version; in the free tier the change is applied without history.

tools.name: clause_delete
tools.description: Remove a clause from the library. A deleted starter clause is not re-seeded on the next call.

tools.name: clause_list
tools.description: List every clause, newest categories first, optionally narrowed to one category.

tools.name: clause_search
tools.description: Ranked search over clause titles, tags, categories and bodies. Title and tag matches outrank body matches. Filtering by jurisdiction or tags is a Pro feature.

tools.name: clause_import
tools.description: Call this tool to bulk-load clauses into the library from a markdown or JSON file. Returns how many clauses were added, replaced, skipped and blocked by the free clause cap, plus the new library total.

tools.name: clause_export
tools.description: Call this tool to write the whole clause library out to one file. Returns the destination path, the format used and how many clauses were written.

tools.name: contract_assemble
tools.description: Call this tool to build a contract or proposal document from library clauses. Returns the path written, the clauses used in document order, which variables were filled, and the facts still missing as bracketed prompts.

tools.name: variables_list
tools.description: Given a set of clauses, list every {{variable}} they use and which clause uses it, so nothing is missed before assembling.
